name: orchestra
description: Runs .scratch, GitHub or Jira issues one at a time in unattended worker sessions, each in its own Ghostty tab, shows them on a live board, and wakes the orchestrator when a worker reports

workerPrompt.title: Worker prompt
workerPrompt.description: The first prompt of each worker session; {issue} is replaced by the issue's path, #42 for a GitHub issue, or CORE-42 for a Jira story

permissionMode.title: Worker permission mode
permissionMode.description: The --permission-mode each worker session starts with

model.title: Worker model
model.description: The --model each worker session starts with; empty keeps your default
